headlines.title: Families fight to sue Roblox
headlines.description: One mother in Georgia is fighting for the right to sue Roblox after a predator targeted her daughter through the platform. Roblox is facing 160 lawsuits alleging it could have done more to protect children. Families now have to fight a mandatory arbitration in the platform’s terms of use. Roblox denies liability in the cases. NBC News’ Laura Jarrett has the story.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy murder case ends in mistrial
headlines.description: The mistrial came after an extraordinary final day in which the defense made a last-ditch appeal to Massachusetts’ top court over a juror it said was blocking a not guilty verdict. NBC News’ Emilie Ikeda reports.

headlines.title: Trump gets a big win at the Supreme Court and the NBA hands out a massive punishment: The news quiz
headlines.description: A former congressman got hit with a ban, an artist had his upcoming Met Gala exhibition pulled, and a record carrier deployment finally came to an end.

headlines.title: Mail-in ballot fight heads to Supreme Court
headlines.description: The Trump administration is asking the Supreme Court to green-light a new Postal Service rule that would exert control over mail-in ballots ahead of the midterm elections. NBC News' Lawrence Hurley explains the request and what's at stake.

headlines.title: DATELINE FRIDAY SNEAK PEEK: The Grudge
headlines.description: Andrea Canning speaks with U.S. District Court Judge Esther Salas about the deadly 2020 shooting at her home that killed her son, Daniel, and critically injured her husband, Mark. Andrea Canning reports Friday, September 4, at 10/9c on NBC.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.title: Man duct-taped to plane seat after hurling slurs and attacking other passenger, witness says
headlines.description: A passenger aboard a Newark, New Jersey-bound American Airlines flight was duct-taped to his seat on Thursday and later arrested after allegedly hurling racial slurs at staff and fighting with another man. The passenger was “thrashing around” in his seat as the flight crew and other passengers tried to restrain him at the rear of the first-class cabin, according to witness Michelle Ng-Reyes.
